With strong scientific knowledge and experience in the regulatory requirements of both the international and domestic industry market, analytical development group of BOC Sciences has evolved to interleave with drug discovery, pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. State-of-the-art technologies and instrumentation along with close collaboration with synthetic organic chemists ensures the highest quality project execution that the right questions are asked and the right tools are used to solve even the most difficult problems. - Purity testing of starting materials and raw materials 
- Structural identification of impurities and degradation products 
- Structural elucidation and chemical characterisation of the intermediates and final compound 
- Physical & Chemical Characterisation Study of the compounds provided by customers

We develop everything from simple formulations for early studies to more complex formulations suited for commercialisation. - Automated formulation screening 
- Drug substance and excipient compatibility studies
- Early screening for structural and chemical stability
- Development of formulations for preclinical studies and clinical studies Phase I to III

- Scale-up and pilot scale manufacturing
- Technology transfer and process validation

- Inhalation and nasal product development

DESCRIPTION:
Rheodyne 7725/7725i front loading HPLC Sample Injectors are easy to use, and provide chromatographers with the Rheodyne Hallmark of Excellence..., unparalleled performance and exceptional product lifetime.

• Patented Make-Before-Break (MBB) architecture virtually eliminates transient pressure shocks for extended column life
• Available in stainless steel and PEEK for sample compatibility
• Zero sample loss
• Wide 30° port angles for easy access
• Small diameter internal flow paths assure minimal dispersion

The Model 7725 and 7725i are Rheodynes most advanced sample injectors for analytical HPLC. They can inject from 1 ml to 5 ml with high accuracy and precision. These versatile injectors can use either of two methods for loading the sample loop. The partial filling method uses the syringe to measure the sample volume. It lets you vary volume easily without having to change the loop, and it does not waste any sample. Any amount up to half the loop volume can be loaded. The amount injected into the column is the exact volume dispensed from the syringe. The complete filling method uses the loop to measure the volume. It lets you load the loop without having to read syringe calibrations carefully. Excess sample is required to completely flush mobile phase from the loop. The amount injected is the volume of the loop.
Flow switching occurs at a flat interface between a polymeric rotor seal and a ceramic stator face. This combination provides long seal life. In a clean system, the 7725 typically can make more than 30,000 injections before requiring replacement of the rotor seal.

DESCRIPTION:
Raman Spectroscopy (Raman Analysis) enables you to determine the chemical structure of a sample and identify the compounds present by measuring molecular vibrations, similar to Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR). However, Raman yields better spatial resolution and enables the analysis of smaller areas.
Raman is a good technique for the qualitative analysis of organic and/or inorganic mixed materials and can also be employed for semi-quantitative and quantitative analysis. It is often used to:
•Identify organic molecules, polymers, biomolecules, and inorganic compounds both in the bulk and in individual particles
•Raman imaging and depth profiling is used to map the distribution of components in mixtures, such as drugs in excipients, tablets, and drug-eluting stent coatings
•Determine the presence of different carbon types (diamond, graphitic, amorphous carbon, diamond-like carbon, nanotubes, etc.) and their relative proportions, something for which it is particularly well suited
•Determine inorganic oxides and their valence state
•Measure the stress and crystalline structure in semiconductor and other materials

We offers our customers Raman services to analyze small contamination areas, identify materials in small areas, and measure stress. The resulting data helps our clients resolve problems quickly, reduce cycle times, and improve production processes. We believe that no competing lab can match the skill set and experience of our staff. Plus, you can count on fast report delivery, accurate data, and person-to-person service, ensuring you understand the information that you receive.

Pharmaceutical excipients are inactive substances in the drug which help in modulating the solubility, bioavailability, and stability of active substances for formulating final drug dosage forms. The excipients form the major part of any medicinal product and the proportion of it, when compared to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), exceeds two to three folds in any pharmaceutical preparations. DESCRIPTION:
Pharmaceutical excipients are inactive substances in the drug which help in modulating the solubility, bioavailability, and stability of active substances for formulating final drug dosage forms. The excipients form the major part of any medicinal product and the proportion of it, when compared to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), exceeds two to three folds in any pharmaceutical preparations. Hence, various characteristics such as functionality, regulatory status, sources, cost, consistency, bioavailability, physicochemical properties, stability, pharmacokinetic parameters, etc. play a major role in determining the suitability of a substance as an excipient.

DESIGN, SYNTHESIS AND ANALYSIS OF CHEMICALS

Draconis Pharma provides medicinal chemistry services that help to progress drug discovery projects from hit identification, through lead optimization, to effective drug candidates. Even in the early stages, compounds are designed taking into account all relevant properties including biological activity, selectivity, pharmacokinetics and toxicological properties, as well as patentability. The company has a compound library of ca 18,000 compounds of which 60% are proprietary compounds to use in HTS experiments. In addition, the company has a virtual library with 0.6 million compounds readily synthesizable ready to use in molecular modeling studies as a source of novel chemistry. 

Services include:
-	Hit-to-Lead & Lead Optimization campaigns
-	Design and synthesis of focused libraries
-	Scaffold hopping and backup chemotypes
-	Synthesis of non-commercially building blocks and scaffolds, reference compounds, metabolites and impurities
-	Optimization of synthetic routes and scale-up chemistry

The company analytical capabilities include the following instruments: HPLC,UPLC/MS, semi-preparative HPLC-MS, 300 MHz NMR, FT-IR, DSC and capillary electrophoresis.

DESCRIPTION:
Pharmaceutical excipients are inactive substances in the drug which help in modulating the solubility, bioavailability, and stability of active substances for formulating final drug dosage forms. The excipients form the major part of any medicinal product and the proportion of it, when compared to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), exceeds two to three folds in any pharmaceutical preparations. Hence, various characteristics such as functionality, regulatory status, sources, cost, consistency, bioavailability, physicochemical properties, stability, pharmacokinetic parameters, etc. play a major role in determining the suitability of a substance as an excipient.

As estimated by IQ4I Research, the pharmaceutical excipients global market is expected to grow at mid single-digit CAGR from 2022 to 2029 to reach $15,439.6 million by 2029. The pharmaceutical excipients market is segmented based on source, products, functionality, and dosage forms.

- metabolites of APIs observed during clinical testing

Avista Pharma’s integrated team excels at tackling such problems efficiently and providing concise professional reports suitable for inclusion in regulatory filings.

Price: $5,000 to $8,000;      Duration: 3 to 5 days
Chiral Screen: We screen the given racemate against more than 384 chiral separation conditions to effectively identify all commercially viable conditions for both +ve and -ve enantiomers. Using our high-throughput screening kits with patent-pending technology, we can provide the results within 3 to 5 days. 
How it works: Each 96-vial kit contains unique combination of pre-calibrated amount of chiral resolving agent and polar solvent. We use 4 different such kits (comprising of 384 unique conditions). During the experiment racemate is added to each vial of the kit with 1:1 ratio with the resolving agent. The kits are then heated together in water bath to up to 800C and then cooled to ambient temperature for 24 hours. The vials with crystals then show +ve results and need to be analyzed further to check if any enantiomeric enrichment was achieved. Analysis is done using Digital Polarimeter (to read +ve or –ve specific rotation) and / or through chiral HPLC. 
Results: Delivery includes:
•	Results Charts that show the amount of crystals and the specific rotation for the vials which yielded the +ve results. Based on the amount of yield and specific rotation, we also identify the best 3 resolution conditions. 
•	Vials with +ve results (both crystals and filtrate) so the customer can validate the results
**Note: All our services are considered “research projects” since the results are dependant on many factors including the type of target racemate. As such we cannot guarantee that target enantiomeric purity will be achieved. Work is done on a best-effort basis.

Key Benefits
•	Confidence that you have considered all commercially viable conditions for the chiral resolution of your racemate. This allows you to establish IP foundation fully
•	Provides number of possibilities for rapid preparation of enantiomer for early lead identification and preclinical testing

During the experiment racemate is added to each vial of the kit with 1:1 ratio with the resolving agent. The kits are then heated together in water bath to up to 800C and then cooled to ambient temperature for 24 hours. The vials with crystals then show +ve results and need to be analyzed further to check if any enantiomeric enrichment was achieved. Analysis is done using Digital Polarimeter (to read +ve or –ve specific rotation) and / or through chiral HPLC. 
Results: Delivery includes:
•	Results Charts that show the amount of crystals and the specific rotation for the vials which yielded the +ve results. Based on the amount of yield and specific rotation, we also identify the best 3 resolution conditions. 
•	Vials with +ve results (both crystals and filtrate) so the customer can validate the results
**Note: All our services are considered “research projects” since the results are dependant on many factors including the type of target racemate. As such we cannot guarantee that target enantiomeric purity will be achieved. Work is done on a best-effort basis.

Key Benefits
•	Confidence that you have considered all commercially viable conditions for the chiral resolution of your racemate. This allows you to establish IP foundation fully
•	Provides number of possibilities for rapid preparation of enantiomer for early lead identification and preclinical testing

Hence, various characteristics such as functionality, regulatory status, sources, cost, consistency, bioavailability, physicochemical properties, stability, pharmacokinetic parameters, etc. play a major role in determining the suitability of a substance as an excipient.

DESCRIPTION:
**CHIRAL ANALYTICAL SERVICES**

Because chirality is involved in most of the chemistry performed chiral analytical support has to be the best. No less than four LC systems and one GC system are primarily used to separate optical isomers by chiral chromatography. Resolving enantiomers can be painstaking sometimes but with our experience, extensive assortment of chiral columns and automated method development setup our rate of success is over 99%.

**PREPARATIVE CHIRAL HPLC**

The purification equipment can be used for preparative chiral separations as well. This means that  enantiomers from a wide range of chiral compounds can be resolved and isolated in high optical purity and chemical yield.

DESCRIPTION:
Pharmaceutical excipients are inactive substances in the drug which help in modulating the solubility, bioavailability, and stability of active substances for formulating final drug dosage forms. The excipients form the major part of any medicinal product and the proportion of it, when compared to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), exceeds two to three folds in any pharmaceutical preparations. Hence, various characteristics such as functionality, regulatory status, sources, cost, consistency, bioavailability, physicochemical properties, stability, pharmacokinetic parameters, etc. play a major role in determining the suitability of a substance as an excipient.

As estimated by IQ4I Research, the pharmaceutical excipients global market is expected to grow at mid single-digit CAGR from 2022 to 2029 to reach $15,439.6 million by 2029. The pharmaceutical excipients market is segmented based on source, products, functionality, and dosage forms.

DESCRIPTION:
Pharmaceutical excipients are inactive substances in the drug which help in modulating the solubility, bioavailability, and stability of active substances for formulating final drug dosage forms. Draconis Pharma provides medicinal chemistry services that help to progress drug discovery projects from hit identification, through lead optimization, to effective drug candidates. Even in the early stages, compounds are designed taking into account all relevant properties including biological activity, selectivity, pharmacokinetics and toxicological properties, as well as patentability. The company has a compound library of ca 18,000 compounds of which 60% are proprietary compounds to use in HTS experiments. In addition, the company has a virtual library with 0.6 million compounds readily synthesizable ready to use in molecular modeling studies as a source of novel chemistry. 

Services include:
-	Hit-to-Lead & Lead Optimization campaigns
-	Design and synthesis of focused libraries
-	Scaffold hopping and backup chemotypes
-	Synthesis of non-commercially building blocks and scaffolds, reference compounds, metabolites and impurities
-	Optimization of synthetic routes and scale-up chemistry

The company analytical capabilities include the following instruments: HPLC,UPLC/MS, semi-preparative HPLC-MS, 300 MHz NMR, FT-IR, DSC and capillary electrophoresis.
